body: Consumer contract for Learnings management UI: reuse the existing approved source card Done summary commits to expose verified guardrail worker commits (deduplicated with legitimate outputs.commits), alongside the new operation/prepared-result receipt provenance. Learnings UI can then follow source.cardId through getKanbanCard without inventing mutable fields on immutable LearningRecord. Do not mark a generated card Done or populate approved summary before final verified transaction. Ordinary source-card summaries remain unchanged.
